trap.label: mesmo sujeito
trap.wrong: Having been signalled, the room stayed calm.
trap.right: Having been signalled, they stayed calm.
trap.why: O português aceita “avisados, a sala ficou calma”. Em inglês, o sujeito do particípio e da principal é o mesmo.

mcq.q: Having been ___ , he left. (he was fired)

opts: Not having been told, she asked.
Having not been told, she asked it.

fix.wrong: Having been told, the room left.
Having not been told, she asked.
fix.right: Not having been told, she asked.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “After he was told, he left.”
Ativa: “After she seen it, she agreed.”
Negativa passiva: “Because she was not told, she asked.”
rewrite.answer: Not having been told, she asked.
